=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:518-712 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The quoted `python3 - <<'PY'` heredoc in the gate step is indented, so the shell does not recognize the terminator and the materiality gate breaks.
  WHY: minimax and x-ai describe a runtime heredoc failure; moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 explicitly disputed the finding and said the terminator is correctly aligned, so this remains a reviewer disagreement on correctness.
- scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh:221-351 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `detect_new_top_level_dirs` can return no matches on orchestrator integration branches, so new top-level-directory signals are silently missed.
  WHY: all three reviewers tied the failure to the `origin/${BASE_BRANCH}...HEAD`/merge-base diff path; minimax called it medium while moonshot and x-ai called it high, so the consensus uses the highest severity.
- scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh:416-433 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The helper catches all Python exceptions and falls back to a zero-advisory result, so materiality-detection failures are hidden and no advisory may be emitted.
  WHY: x-ai says the bare `except Exception` logs to stderr, writes fallback JSON, and exits 0; moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 disagreed and said this is the intended non-blocking fail-open behavior.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

Wire the helper into .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml so it can run in parallel with reviewer work and emit a non-blocking advisory comment under the AI Materiality Advisory heading when appropriate. Add the phase-D fixture patch and one focused regression test."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh; .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml; tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: minimax says the test fixture only covers the basic package.json case, not the new-top-level-directory detection path; moonshot says the workflow comment step and phase-D fixture/test already exist; x-ai says the new-top-level-directory rule remains non-functional on orchestrator integration branches, the gate classifier never sees Git state, and the advisory-post logic can silently drop failures.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~684 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Python heredoc uses an indented `PY` terminator, so bash does not recognize it as the closing delimiter.
  WHY: The gate classifier will fail at runtime and fall back to default behavior.
- scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh:221-270 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function uses `git diff --name-status -M --diff-filter=AR ${base_ref}...HEAD` to detect new top-level directories, and that comparison can produce no results on orchestrator integration branches.
  WHY: On integration-branch PRs, the new-top-level-directory signal silently produces no matches, even when genuinely new top-level directories exist.
- TASK_GAP 1 - MEDIUM SEVERITY
  Requirement: "Add scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh with a deterministic path-glob classifier for high / medium / low materiality. Keep the LLM fallback flags present but disabled by default; v1 should remain deterministic unless the explicit fallback flag is enabled later."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh and/or tests
  Evidence of absence: The deterministic path-glob classifier is implemented and functional for pure path rules. However, the inline Python classifier in the workflow gate (review_autofix.yml) has a critical syntax bug (indented heredoc terminator) that prevents it from running at all. The test fixture only covers the basic package.json case, not the new-top-level-directory detection path.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh:264-351 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The function relies on `origin/${BASE_BRANCH}...HEAD` for git diff, which can fail on orchestrator integration branches where the base ref topology does not align with the checked-out branch.
  WHY: On orchestrator-managed PRs with integration branches, git may fail to resolve the merge-base or the triple-dot diff range, causing the function to silently return an empty list and miss new-top-level-directory signals that should trigger a high materiality advisory.
- Requirement: "Wire the helper into .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml so it can run in parallel with reviewer work and emit a non-blocking advisory comment under the AI Materiality Advisory heading when appropriate."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml "Post AI Materiality Advisory comment" step
  Evidence of absence: The implementation is complete - the step exists at lines 3688-3749 with proper continue-on-error: true, marker-based deduplication, and edit-in-place support.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Add the phase-D fixture patch and one focused regression test."
  Expected change site: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
  Evidence of absence: The implementation is complete - PHASE_D_MATERIALITY_FIXTURE is defined, test_agents_md_materiality_classifier_and_workflow_wiring() covers positive/satisfied/low cases plus gate classifier assertions.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:518-712 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The heredoc terminator `PY` is indented, so the shell parser never sees a valid closing delimiter and the gate logic breaks.
  WHY: Bash requires the exact terminator string at column 0 for a quoted heredoc; the materiality gate becomes non-functional if that line remains indented.
- scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh:284-310 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Git ref comparison only succeeds when the checked-out branch is a direct descendant of the declared base branch, so the structural-change signal can disappear on orchestrator integration branches.
  WHY: When the triple-dot diff range cannot be resolved cleanly, the function returns an empty list and the “new top-level directory” high-materiality advisory never fires.
- scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh:416-433 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Any Python exception is caught, a generic warning is printed, a fallback zero-advisory JSON is written, and the script exits with code 0.
  WHY: High-materiality detection failures therefore produce no comment and no escalation, which hides exactly the failure mode the advisory is meant to surface.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: “Add scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh with a deterministic path-glob classifier for high / medium / low materiality. […] Wire the helper into .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml so it can run in parallel with reviewer work and emit a non-blocking advisory comment […] Add the phase-D fixture and one focused regression test.” (and “Keep the advisory non-blocking. […] Do not edit […] agents.md […] here”)
  Expected change site: scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh (especially `detect_new_top_level_dirs` + its integration in `main()`) and the gate in review_autofix.yml
  Evidence of absence: The path-glob rules work for the package.json fixture, but the repo-verified “new top-level directory” rule (explicitly called out as a high-materiality helper-only signal) is non-functional on orchestrator integration branches. The gate’s duplicated inline Python classifier never sees Git state, the test harness only exercises the gate (not the Git path), and the advisory-post logic can silently drop failures. The Phase-D fixture and contract test were added, but they do not cover the broken helper path. No edit was made to agents.md per constraints.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
